canada.summary: Some Iris Kirby House residents are getting ready to move back in after being displaced from the St. John’s shelter after a flood two weeks ago.

canada.title: Wet, windy weather drives concern for people experiencing homelessness on Vancouver Island
canada.summary: Outreach workers and advocates for people experiencing homelessness on Vancouver Island say they're concerned about the effects of a prolonged series of fall storms on people living rough on the street, especially in communities with no additional shelter space for winter.

canada.title: Bridge’s old bones get new life
canada.summary: It’s no secret Winnipeg’s Arlington Bridge is coming down. The 114-year-old steel-truss structure had reached the end of its life several years ago as a well-worn corridor connecting the city’s north and central neighbourhoods.

canada.title: Parents of autistic teen detained by Alberta RCMP demand release of delayed watchdog report
canada.summary: The parents of an autistic teenager who was arrested at an Alberta playground and detained by RCMP four years ago are calling for the results of a watchdog investigation to be released.

canada.title: Ontario Career college saw OSAP use rise by 6,000%, yet avoided funding cut off this spring
canada.summary: An Ontario career college with four campuses saw the amount of students receiving financial aid explode over a few years, including an increase of nearly 6,000 per cent at one campus, but it was not one of the schools the government cut off this spring.

canada.title: If the N.W.T. wants an addictions treatment centre, ‘we'd look to discuss,’ says its MP
canada.summary: There is currently no inpatient addictions treatment centre in the territory. Residents who need such care are sent to facilities down south.

canada.title: Small community of Inkerman chosen as site for new Acadian Peninsula warming centre
canada.summary: Inkerman, a small northern community, has been selected as the location for a warming centre on the Acadian Peninsula this winter. Last year, six beds were made available for homeless people at the Peninsula's airport, near Caraquet.

canada.title: Sask. appeal court denies province's appeal in birth alerts class action suit
canada.summary: The Court of Appeal upheld a lower court's ruling that reports from the Truth and Reconciliation Commission and National Inquiry into Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls are admissible in the suit.

canada.title: A lifetime of art: Ruth Smillie receives University of Regina's highest honour
canada.summary: Ruth Smillie has dedicated her life to the arts, primarily the Saskatchewan theatre scene. On Thursday, the University of Regina awarded her its highest honour.

canada.title: Akwesasne elder makes history as first graduate of McGill’s Indigenous languages PhD program
canada.summary: At 73, Mary Onwá Tekahawáhkwen Macdonald is the first graduate of McGill’s Indigenous language revitalization PhD program.

canada.title: Federal review finds no single, unusual neurological illness or cause among N.B. patients
canada.summary: The Public Health Agency of Canada says it found no evidence of a single, unusual neurological illness or a common cause in its review of more than 200 so-called mystery brain disease cases in New Brunswick.

canada.title: Data centre’s signed deal with Nova Scotia Power ties new system costs to EverWind

Microsoft said progress is being made in bringing its popular workplace software back online as a global outage enters its second day, disrupting business communications, police emergency calls, court operations and AI tools, The Associated Press reports.
Man dead from gunshot found in house in Surrey, CityNews Vancouver reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
